remarks: Luxury New Construction in the Heart of New Canaan!    Experience the finest in modern living with this exceptional new home by Kaeser Custom Homes, renowned for quality craftsmanship and timeless design. Ideally situated near Mead Memorial Park and Bristow Bird Sanctuary, this elegant residence offers the perfect blend of nature, convenience, and luxury-with sidewalk access to town for ultimate enjoyment.   Spanning over 6,600 square feet across four beautifully finished levels, this 5 ensuite bedroom, 6 full and 2 half-bath masterpiece is thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and stylish entertaining.   Highlights include:  Gourmet chef's kitchen with top-tier appliances opens to a spacious family room with a fireplace.  Luxurious primary suite with fireplace, spa-like bath and walk-in closet. Private home office, formal dining, and flexible living spaces. Finished lower level ideal for a gym, media room, or golf simulator.   Set on a picturesque lot with professionally landscaped grounds, this home is a rare opportunity to own a newly built property in one of New Canaan's in-town neighborhoods. Pool Site Permit has been approved!
